title: FLARE v7.14 Oregon public demonstration sample, July 16, 2026, 18:01–18:26 UTC
description: Public demonstration subset: six experimental native-grid scenes for July 16, 2026, 18:01–18:26 UTC inclusive, at five-minute intervals. NetCDF4 preserves source values on a 545 by 1425 grid. Includes Python/Jupyter examples. The separate full 25-scene dataset is intended for restricted Zenodo access and is not included here. Reconstructed values are not direct VIIRS observations. Radiance physical units remain unverified. FireScore is not a probability.
